notes.title: Godfist unreal engine 5 update
notes.notes:
The time has finally come to step into the future.

This is the first Icehelm game that gets updated from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5.

So what does this mean? This mean that the game gets a visual upgrade, specifically Lumen which is realtime global illumination. It also give players Temporal Super Resolution (TSR), which is a much more smoother AA experience compared to FXAA.

Also thanks to the engine update there have also been some fixes that has plagued the Godfist.
But that's not all, there is also a new added enemy. The Void Ghost.

This a weak but fast enemy that is almost invisible except for his big red eyes. So be sure to watch out for him.

Here are the current changes for the Unreal Engine 5 update.

[b]Added [/b]

[list]
[*] Unreal Engine 5 update
[*] realtime global illumination
[*] new enemy Void Ghost
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Floating point errors, this was causing the player to take more push damage at the end of the tower.
[*] Jaggy animations. Some users had problems with animations being a bit jarring, this update should fix that.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43317384/ac687ceafeb6396927473cfe71882f530e43b7a0.png[/img]

That's all for now, until next time
Icehelm out

notes.title: Godfist Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I hope you're all enjoying Godfist. There seems to be no major breaking issues which is great, however there were some minor stuff that needed to be addressed.

Take a peek below to see what has been changed/fixed

Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed wrong unlock. You'll now be able to unlock the barbarian.
[/list]

Changes
[list]
[*] Level up now has a dedicated button (Tab or special button left on Xbox controllers)
[*] There's now an indicator telling you that you have a level up point.
[*] The pool of death is now slightly less deadly, instead of instant death you'll take massive damage. It will still work like before on enemies.
[*] Unlockable characters are now more visible and you can hear them.
[*] Unlockable characters level spawning has been lowered, you will now be able to unlock them sooner.
[*] The starting area now has an ability chest, this it to make each run a bit more interesting.
[*] Crossbow bolts should now hit where you aim and not below.
[*] The knight special ability has been increased from 5 seconds to 8 seconds.
[*] Player abilities that explode will no longer damage the player.
[*] Player abilities that explosions now have a slightly larger area of effect and do a little more damage.
[*] Health stations now have a 65% chance of spawning, instead of 33%
[*] Item magnetism will start much soon than before
[/list]

Enemy changes
[list]
[*] The void brawlers attack damage has been decreased from 20 to 15.
[*] The void knight melee attack has been decreased from 35 to 25.
[*] The void bombers damage have been reduced from 45 to 35.
[*] The void crossbowman's bolt damage have been reduced from 10 to 5, making a total damage of 25 instead of 50 on a full hit.
[*] The void soldiers fireball damage have been reduced from 15 to 10.
[/list]

Cheers
/Icehelm

notes.title: Godfist Demo update 2
notes.notes:
Second update of the godfist demo fixes a lot of bugs and adds some balance changes.

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]New enemy added "Void Shinobi"
[*]Added tutorial
[*]Added key rebinding
[*]Added nicer UI elements to setting menu
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]How the slot mechanic works have been completely changed, no longer cost gold and rerolls after using an ability
[*]All abilities have been buffed except the spear
[*]All enemies have been rebalanced
[*]Chest and merchant will always spawn in the middle of the arena
[*]First merchant won't sell anything and will only appear on every third level
[*]Buying an upgrade at the merchant will now be removed after bought
[*]Added more enemies per floor
[*]Kick now has longer range
[*]Parry will stun enemies even if they aren't doing an attack animation
[*]Blocking has been removed and is now a pick up / throw item ability
[*]Changing the sound volume should now save
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Inputs will now longer work when falling to your death
[*]The smash ability now works as intended
[/list]
														
That's all for now. More to come!

Cheers
/Icehelm

notes.title: 🔴 Slot Building FPS Roguelike - GODFIST 🎰🤜💥
